description.narrative:
Denmark provides core contribution to UN Women under the Multilateral Partnership Agreement 2023-2025. The Agreement aligns with UN Women's Strategic Plan 2022-2025 and identifies four areas of priority for Danish support: o Global norms, policies and standards on gender equality, incl. the SRHR agenda o Women’s voice, leadership, agency and economic empowerment o Women, Peace and Security o Organisational effectiveness contributing to UN reform and curbing corruption
As the United Nation’s entity dedicated to gender equality, UN Women, works to achieve the empowerment of all women and girls and the full enjoyment of their human rights. This is done through their unique triple mandate: 1) Co-promote coordination across the UN system to enhance accountability and results for gender equality and women’s empowerment; 2) support UN Member States to strengthen global norms and standards for gender equality and women’s empowerment; and; 3) undertake operational activities, including supporting Member States in developing and implementing gender-responsive laws, policies and strategies.
